## About
Max Motors is a family owned and operated repair shop on American St in San Carlos. We handle repair, maintenance and diagnostics on most domestic and foreign vehicles, from Toyota and Honda to BMW, Mercedes and Subaru.
We are a State certified smog inspection and repair shop, and we work with trained technicians, computerized diagnostic equipment and quality name brand parts. We keep a computer record of every service we do on your car, so we know its history the next time you come in.
We hold a 4.8 rating from 33 Google reviews. Customers often mention Avy by name for explaining the work in plain language. And when you stop by, Ruvi, our residential dog, will probably meet you at the door.

## Services
- Smog inspection and repair: State certified smog inspections and the repairs that go with them, done in house.
- Oil change with inspection: Every oil change includes a look over your fluids, belts, hoses, filters, brakes, tires, battery, steering and suspension. High mileage, synthetic blend and full synthetic options are available.
- Check engine light, brake and suspension repairs: Check engine light repairs, brake work, front suspension, rear ends, transmissions and the hard to find problems.
- Engine and transmission work: From routine maintenance up to engine and transmission repairs and rebuilds.
- Tune-ups and preventive maintenance: Tune-up, diagnostic and maintenance services that follow your manufacturer's recommended schedule.
- Fleet preventive maintenance: A preventive maintenance program custom designed for your company vehicles, with checks on tire pressure, fluids, belts and hoses to help keep them on the road.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: Most domestic and foreign vehicles, including Toyota, Mazda, VW, Audi, Saab, Subaru, BMW, Mercedes, Acura, Honda and Nissan.

Q: Do you keep track of my car's service history?
A: Yes. We keep a computer record of each maintenance service we perform on your vehicle.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where is the shop?
A: We are at 945 American St in San Carlos, CA 94070.
